name: Qwen 3.5 35B
short: Alibaba's Feb 2026 open-weight MoE (36B total/3B active, Apache 2.0) for cheap multimodal agents: GPQA 84.2%, SWE-bench Verified 69.2%, LiveCodeBench v6 74.6% at $0.14/$1.00 - not on Zen.

standout: The 3B-active sweet spot: full multimodal reasoning and coding at price levels that make always-on agents viable.
tradeoff: Small-active depth — it handles breadth cheaply, not frontier difficulty.
